newsitem.title: USA: Leading Edge won't enter Sun joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Leading Edge won't enter Sun joint venture.

text.p: Leading Edge Packaging Inc said Monday that its joint venture agreement with privately held Sun's Printing and Packaging Co Ltd to market and distribute paper shopping bags will not be consummated.

Leading Edge said it plans to pursue this market and believes that its marketing and sales force can successfully sell and distribute high quality paper shopping bags, premium paper items and specialty novelty paper boxes.
Leading Edge sells and distributes packaging products used primarily in the sale of luxury consumer goods.
